So we can fetch those. Then we can provide the current price and maybe compare to previous close. But we don't have previous close. We can just give current price. That might suffice.

We can also get the watchlist. But the user didn't mention watchlist. They want market status. So we can call get_current_time to get the time. Then we can call get_stock_info for SPY, QQQ, DIA. Then we can provide the current price. That might be enough. Let's do that.
